findings.excerpt: Definitions and formulas such as W(s), W_ε, Q_hg, ∂_xW_ε, node/cell data, and error bounds are written as bare ASCII/TeX in prose.
findings.symptom: The original-resolution captures show the long Given/F1–F5 prose and counterexample formulas in baseline text; commands including \partial_x and subscripts print literally instead of as math. The arithmetic/proof remains legible, but its notation is not typeset.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap mathematical expressions consistently in math delimiters, including the displayed data and proof formulas; preserve ordinary explanatory prose.

findings.excerpt: The purported diagram is authored as a center environment containing a TikZ picture of the fundamental square and paired opposite edges.
findings.symptom: The captured ItemBody displays the entire \begin{center}/\begin{tikzpicture} block and node/draw commands as literal text; no diagram is produced.
findings.suggested_repair: Express this topology schematic using a TikZ form supported by the application ItemBody renderer, or use an authored supported diagram syntax while retaining the paired-edge identifications.

findings.excerpt: The `tikzcd` commuting square maps Piola push-forward and divergence between reference and physical fields.
findings.symptom: The captured preview replaces the diagram with a red “diagram failed to render” box and literal diagram source, so the square and its arrows/labels are absent.
findings.suggested_repair: Repair the `tikzcd` input so the renderer accepts the arrow-label and row syntax, then verify the reference/physical spaces, divergence arrows, and Jacobian-weighted scalar pull-forward in the rendered square.

findings.excerpt: Expressions including g_ij=∇W_ε(q_i−q_j), F_ij=−m_im_j(A_i+A_j)g_ij, g_ji, and F_ji are outside math delimiters.
findings.symptom: The captured Statement, supplier facts, and proof show underscores and formulas as ordinary baseline text rather than mathematical notation.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the force, kernel-gradient, and indexed relations in math mode throughout the Statement, Facts, and Proof.

findings.excerpt: Two display residual inequalities and the following “where τ^n...” clause are delimited around the PDE and statement formula.
findings.symptom: Two KaTeX parse errors are visible in the red text: one begins at the PDE display and runs through the first residual bound; the second begins in the following “where τ^n...” sentence. The relevant expressions appear as raw TeX rather than rendered math.
findings.suggested_repair: Correct the math delimiter boundaries around the PDE, residual estimates, and following prose so each expression parses as a complete display or inline formula.

editorial_candidates.source_claim: The unit-weight bilinear map F(ξ,η)=(ξ,η(1−2ξ)) folds the unit square across ξ=1/2; its Jacobian changes sign there, and distinct points (1/2,0),(1/2,1) have the same image.
editorial_candidates.why_warranted: The counterexample turns on a geometric fold and loss of injectivity, which are easy to see in a domain/map sketch.
editorial_candidates.content_to_draw_or_check: Show the parameter square split by ξ=1/2, label the zero-Jacobian fold line and opposite Jacobian signs, and mark the distinct top/bottom points mapping to (1/2,0). Do not imply positivity of weights ensures any other admissibility property.
editorial_candidates.limitation: Optional explanatory schematic; the algebraic verification already proves both failures and does not rely on a drawing.

existing_diagram_checks.map_orientation_index_sign_review: The five successfully rendered diagrams were checked against their prose and definitions: the cell/face average labels and skew-cell construction in the hybrid mimetic diagram, endpoint weights in the periodic interpolation diagram, center-to-face normal and resistance-distance geometry in the TPFA diagram, shared rays and cell splits in the disk mesh sketch, and the three-node wraparound edge in the periodic graph. No incorrect orientation, index, sign, or relationship was visible. The Piola commuting square is failed and therefore cannot be mathematically read from its rendered preview.
